div.div: 2 أزّى الحَوْضَ , inf. n. تَأْزِيَةٌ (S, K) and تَأْزِىْءٌ, or تَوْزِىْءٌ, (accord. to different copies of the S, [the latter irregular,]) or both, (accord. to the TA,) He put, or made, an إِزَآء [q. v.], to the watering-trough or tank; (S, K;) i. e. he put upon its mouth a stone, or a جُلَّة [explained below, voce إِزَآء], or the like; (TA;) as also ↓ آزاهُ , inf. n. إِيزَآءٌ; (S, TA;) or ↓ تأزّاهُ . (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
